Island_104.terrain_character: A compact high-character dryland region centered on an oasis basin, sandstone ridges, dunes, dry gullies, and one or two dramatic canyon-like cuts. Keep the desert footprint intentionally small so every part feels purposeful rather than becoming a broad empty expanse.
Island_104.settlement_role: One primary oasis settlement with a smaller well-town or caravan outpost, using shaded courtyards, markets, gardens, canals, wells, and compact sandstone construction rather than sprawling development.
Island_104.primary_function: Compact desert and oasis terrain experience
Island_104.secondary_feature: Oasis lake or spring, dunes, sandstone cliffs, dry riverbeds, canyon cuts, palm gardens and sheltered irrigated pockets
Island_104.travel_role: A deliberate destination rather than a major through-route. Approaches should funnel through dry valleys or passes before opening suddenly onto the oasis settlement.
Island_104.lore_notes: This region exists to add one concentrated dry-climate terrain experience to the realm without asking the player to build across a huge desert. The oasis is the anchor: scarce water explains settlement, agriculture, trade, and the contrast between harsh outer terrain and a dense inhabited center.
